newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Yields rise on 182-day Lithuanian T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields rise on 182-day Lithuanian T-bills.

text.p: The average yield on 182-day Lithuanian Treasury bills rose on Tuesday to 9.29 percent from the 9.18 percent they fetched at the last auction for six-month paper on July 8, the central bank said.
Amounts are in millions of litas unless otherwise stated.
MATURITY AV YIELD (LAST) MIN/MAX YIELD ISSUE BID SOLD
The settlement date for the auction is July 18, and the bills mature on January 16, 1998.
The next auction will be held on July 21, when 50 million litas of 91-day paper will be offered.
